answer: Each agent may earn reputation only after depositing a stake that is forfeited if it double-signs or fails a randomly assigned task verified by independent peers. New identities start with no reputation, so splitting one account into many does not multiply influence; each must lock fresh funds and build a separate record. The marble ledger records deposits, while a pearl-backed appeal can challenge a false penalty. On the shared terrace, this makes a Sybil attack costly: the attacker must fund every identity and risk losing those stakes.
